forbidden_shortcut: substituting the Einstein trace T=-Mbar_Pl^2*R before deriving the Einstein term is circular in an induced-G calculation
IR_correspondence_only: after an EH branch already exists, T=-Mbar_Pl^2*R maps +b*T*M^2 to -xi_IR*R*M^2/2 with xi_IR=2*b*Mbar_Pl^2
